item.title: Trump Reportedly Expressed ‘Serious Interest’ in Deploying Ground Troops to Iran
item.description: President Donald Trump has privately expressed “serious interest” in deploying U.S. troops on the ground in Iran, according to a Friday report from NBC News citing multiple current and former officials familiar with the discussions. The post Trump Reportedly Expressed ‘Serious Interest’ in Deploying Ground Troops to Iran first appeared on Mediaite.

item.title: Bill Maher Roasts Trump For Rage-Feuding in Middle of War: ‘Tell ME Why!’
item.description: Comedian and pundit Bill Maher roasted President Donald Trump for rage-posting about their feud in the middle of a war, asking Mediaite to "Tell ME why!" The post Bill Maher Roasts Trump For Rage-Feuding in Middle of War: ‘Tell ME Why!’ first appeared on Mediaite.
